default_in_repayment.text:

b)	According to the information and explanations given to us, we report that the Company has not been declared willful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or government or any government authority.

c)	The Company has not taken any term loans during the year and there are no unutilized term loans at the beginning of the year. Accordingly, the provisions of clause 3(ix)(c) of the Order are not applicable.

d)	On an overall examination of the financial statements of the Company, we report that funds raised on short-term basis have prima facie, not been used for long-term purposes by the Company.

e)	The Company did not have any subsidiary, associate, or joint venture. Accordingly, the provisions of clause 3(ix) (e)of the Order are not applicable.
